name: platelet derived growth factor receptor alpha
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: PDGFRA encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and luteinization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to gastrointestinal stromal tumor (autosomal dominant); polyps, multiple and recurrent inflammatory fibroid, gastrointestinal (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Intimal sarcoma; Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype; Gastrointestinal stromal tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
